content:
maya: @oncall paging: infra-bot alerted 5m ago — kube node 'infer-usw2-3' flapping: NotReady -> Ready -> NotReady x4
infra-bot: :rotating_light: Alert: node/infer-usw2-3 status=NotReady reason=KubeletRestarted count=4
maya: I'm paged, looking. Anyone nearby?
sam: on it, swapping from lunch. pulling events.
zack: I'm on call too, will grab node console.
olga: tagging SRE rotation FYI — could impact inference pool for low-lat customers.
maya: quick check: `kubectl get pods -n inference -o wide | grep infer-usw2-3` -> some runtime pods on that node OOMKilled
sam: paste events:

```
Events:
  Warning  KubeletRestarted  2026-03-15T09:12:34Z  kubelet  Kubelet restarted on node infer-usw2-3
  Warning  NodeNotReady      2026-03-15T09:12:37Z  kubelet  Node became NotReady
  Warning  BackOff           2026-03-15T09:13:01Z  kubelet  Back-off restarting failed container serving-runtime
  Normal   Started           2026-03-15T09:14:10Z  kubelet  Started container
  Warning  OOMKilled         2026-03-15T09:14:12Z  kernel   Out of memory: Killed process 11234 (runtime)
```

zack: runtime logs show CUDA driver errors right before OOM:

```
[  ERROR] serving-runtime: session=abc123 error=\"cuMemAlloc failed: out of memory\"
[  ERROR] serving-runtime: fallback -> trying lower-quant model
[  FATAL] container: process exited with code 137
```

maya: impact? any customer-facing errors seen?
olga: Observability: spike in 5xx on route `/v1/generate` in eu-west and usw2 regions, some requests rerouted, default fallback model handled ~60% requests, 40% failed with 503s.
sam: looks like inference autoscaler didn't scale fast due to node flaps — nodes kept cycling.
maya: mitigation plan:
- cordon infer-usw2-3
- drain noncritical pods, let critical inference pods be rescheduled to healthy nodes
- temporarily increase pool min-replicas for inference-dedicated
- enable immediate model-fallback policy to smaller quantized variants
- notify customers via status if impact persists

zack: running `kubectl cordon infer-usw2-3 && kubectl drain infer-usw2-3 --ignore-daemonsets --delete-local-data --force` now
maya: thx. also increasing HPA min for inference-deployment to 6 (from 3)

deploy-bot: Deployment inference-deployment scaled from 3 to 6 replicas by maya via console at 09:22Z
incident-bot: Incident created: #INC-2026-03-15-01 \"infer-node-flap-cuda-ooms\" severity=high lead=maya

sam: checking node kernel logs: frequent nv_peer_mem link failure then oom, suspect bad driver update pushed in image `gpu-ami:v2026-03-14-1`
olga: can we repro on a spare node? zack can you run a small load test on infer-usw2-spare?
zack: running a stress test hitting serving runtime with long sequences and batch=16

```
curl -s -X POST https://internal-infer.svc/v1/generate -d '{"prompt":"x"*2000, "max_tokens":512}' -H 'Authorization: Bearer ...'
```

zack: spare node started throwing `cuCtxCreate: out of memory` after ~50s under that workload. same driver package.
maya: rollback coordinator — rollback `gpu-ami:v2026-03-14-1` to `v2026-03-13-0` for infer pool. is that safe?
sam: yes, older image has passed soak. I'll trigger nodepool rolling upgrade to replace nodes with safe image.

maya: short-term routing: shift critical traffic to ded-hw-usw1 and reduce per-node concurrency limits
olga: adding policy: per-route concurrency 2 for heavy-models; will update console config.

maya: communication: support, please draft a status note: impacted customers might see 503s and higher latencies for generation endpoints, mitigation in progress.
zack: +1. We'll follow up postmortem.

sam: node replace started — cordoned nodes drained and Cordon/Drain complete for infer-usw2-3
deploy-bot: Node group infer-usw2: rollingReplace started by sam at 09:34Z
incident-bot: Pager cleared for maya at 09:43Z — node stability restored, traffic normalized to 95% success
maya: thanks team — keeping incident open for 4h for monitoring and postmortem
olga: capture action items: driver pinning, image rollback policy, autoscaler tweaks, better fallback rules, add smoke test for GPU AMI
maya: assigning actions: sam -> investigate driver regression & publish AMI checklist; zack -> create reproducible test; olga -> update routing policies; maya -> write postmortem
sam: on it.

maya: tl;dr: cause=GPU driver/AMI regression causing repeated OOM & kubelet restarts; node flapping led to capacity churn -> increased 503s; mitigations=cordon/drain, scale up, AMI rollback, routing/concurrency limits.

olga: :thumbsup: nice work, quick containment
maya: closing thread updates in 2h unless new issues pop. :white_check_mark:
